> Fit the detection link of a latent-scale mixed model (how a cell's latent value, such as the log-odds of a site's occupancy, sets the chance that a trial succeeds) by maximum likelihood over cells with a latent mean and SD and a count.

Wire verb `stats fit-link` · Python [`pymzlib.stats.fit_link`][pymzlib.stats.fit_link]

### Wraps

- [`LogitNormalMixedModel.FitLink`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/cc67b7a2/mzLib/StatisticalModels/LogitNormalMixedModel.cs) in `mzLib/StatisticalModels/LogitNormalMixedModel.cs` at mzLib `cc67b7a2`
- [`LinkCell`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/cc67b7a2/mzLib/StatisticalModels/LogitNormalMixedModel.cs) in `mzLib/StatisticalModels/LogitNormalMixedModel.cs` at mzLib `cc67b7a2`
- [`DetectionLink`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/cc67b7a2/mzLib/StatisticalModels/LogitNormalMixedModel.cs) in `mzLib/StatisticalModels/LogitNormalMixedModel.cs` at mzLib `cc67b7a2`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cells` | `path` | required | — | `>= 1 row` | A TSV with a header row naming the columns latent_mean, latent_sd, successes and trials, and optionally depth, in any order and no other (so a misspelt optional column cannot fall back to the default silently), then one row per covered cell (mzLib's LinkCell). latent_mean and latent_sd are the normal the cell's latent value is taken to sit at, in latent units (e.g. the mean and SD of its feature's measured cells, mzLib's example); successes of trials is its count; depth is in the caller's depth unit. Without a depth column every cell is constructed without one, so its depth is LinkCell's own default (0 at cc67b7a2). mzLib refuses a cell with a latent mean, SD or depth that is not finite, an SD below 0, no trials, or more successes than trials. Which cells, and their latent normals, are the caller's modelling choices. |
| `with_depth` (wire `--with-depth`) | `bool` | absent | — | `true \| false` | mzLib's withDepth: fit the depth slope (else it is 0). Absent, the bridge passes FitLink's declared default (false at cc67b7a2), read from mzLib, and echoes it. |
| `with_overdispersion` (wire `--with-overdispersion`) | `bool` | absent | — | `true \| false` | mzLib's withOverdispersion: fit the beta-binomial intra-cell correlation rho (else it is 0, binomial). Absent, FitLink's declared default (false at cc67b7a2), echoed. |
| `detection_only` (wire `--detection-only`) | `bool` | absent | — | `true \| false` | mzLib's detectionOnly. true: fit on whether any trial succeeded, P(k = 0) against P(k >= 1), the event that makes a covered zero. false: fit on the full count, P(k of n). Absent, FitLink's declared default (true at cc67b7a2), echoed. mzLib's documentation: on PTM data the full counts follow occupancy more weakly than detection does, and a link fitted on them predicts covered zeros worse. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cells_file` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the cells table. |
| `cell_count` | `int` | cells | never | Rows read. |
| `depth_given` | `bool` | — | never | Whether the cells file has a depth column. |
| `with_depth` | `bool` | — | never | withDepth as passed: the option given, else mzLib's declared default. |
| `with_overdispersion` | `bool` | — | never | withOverdispersion as passed: the option given, else mzLib's declared default. |
| `detection_only` | `bool` | — | never | detectionOnly as passed: the option given, else mzLib's declared default. |
| `link` | `object` | — | yes: mzLib's search did not converge within its iteration limit (FitLink returned null) | The fitted DetectionLink, ready for stats fit-latent-mixed --link; fields under result.tables.link. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Three static caveats (one says which likelihood was fitted), plus one each when the depth slope or overdispersion was not fitted, when the depth slope was fitted without a depth column, and when the search did not converge. |

Fields of `link`:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `intercept` | `float` | natural log-odds | never | a: the per-trial log-odds at latent 0 and depth 0. |
| `slope` | `float` | natural log-odds per latent unit | never | b: how fast the per-trial log-odds follow the latent. Below 1, the chance of a success rises more slowly than the latent. |
| `depth_slope` | `float` | natural log-odds per depth unit | never | c: the depth term's coefficient; exactly 0 when with_depth is false. |
| `overdispersion` | `float` | fraction (intra-cell correlation, 0 to < 1) | never | rho, the correlation of trials within a cell; exactly 0 when with_overdispersion is false. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | --cells missing, blank or not found; the table empty or header-only; a header with an empty, repeated, missing or unknown column (each named); a row whose field count differs from its header; a latent_mean, latent_sd or depth that is not a number (blank, NA or NaN pass to mzLib); successes or trials not a whole number; --with-depth, --with-overdispersion or --detection-only other than true or false, or without a value |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | mzLib refuses the cells (its ArgumentException, reclassified): a latent mean, SD or depth that is not finite, an SD below 0, no trials, or successes outside 0 to trials |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | never expected |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- Maximum likelihood over the cells, each cell's probability integrated over its latent normal by 12-node adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature and maximized by Nelder-Mead. mzLib returns the point estimate only: no standard errors.
- By default the fit is on detection (any success or none), not on how many trials succeeded: on PTM data, mzLib's documentation says, the full counts follow occupancy more weakly and predict covered zeros worse.
- The link is in natural log-odds and is what stats fit-latent-mixed --link takes. Which cells enter, and their latent means and SDs, are the caller's modelling choices; the bridge builds neither.
- With --with-depth true and no depth column, every cell's depth is 0 and the data say nothing about depth_slope.

### Example

```python
link = pymzlib.stats.fit_link('link_cells.tsv', with_depth=True)
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`stats_fit_link_simulated.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/stats_fit_link_simulated.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.

### References

- [doi:10.1093/comjnl/7.4.308](https://doi.org/10.1093/comjnl/7.4.308): the simplex search mzLib maximizes the link's likelihood with (Nelder and Mead, Comput J 7:308, 1965)
- [doi:10.1093/biomet/81.3.624](https://doi.org/10.1093/biomet/81.3.624): adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature, which integrates each cell's probability over its latent normal (Liu and Pierce, Biometrika 81:624, 1994)
- [doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1948.tb00014.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.2517-6161.1948.tb00014.x): the beta-binomial distribution, the count model with overdispersion (Skellam, J R Stat Soc B 10:257, 1948)
